global_style: An elegant, editorial-style presentation design system featuring a muted earthy palette, overlapping geometric shapes, and a sophisticated serif/sans-serif typography mix.

identity_anchors: Muted, natural color palette anchored by sage green
Elegant serif typography for main headings
Overlapping solid or semi-transparent rectangular color blocks behind text or images
Asymmetrical, magazine-style layouts with generous whitespace
Prominent but subtle slide numbering in large light grey serif type

density_rules.low: Use one focal idea and generous whitespace.
density_rules.medium: Use two to six concise content groups on the observed grid.
density_rules.high: Remove decoration before reducing label size or hierarchy.

variation_rules: Vary image/text balance and emphasis while preserving anchors, grid, and color ratios.
anti_repetition_rules: Do not repeat the same primary composition or decoration placement on adjacent slides.
